phylojunction.distribution.likelihood.ODE.dn_bisse_ode.bisse_d_eqns(t, ds_es, qs, mus, lambdas)

Return Maddison et al. d/dt D(t) equations.

Parameters:

  • t (float) – Time (not used).

  • ds_es (numpy.ndarray) – Values of Ds for states 0 and 1, followed by values of Es, for states 0 and 1.

  • qs (numpy.ndarray) – Two-dimensional array of values of transition rate parameters for states 0 and 1.

  • mus (numpy.ndarray) – Values of extinction rate parameters for states 0 and 1.

  • lambdas (numpy.ndarray) – Values of birth-rate parameters for states 0 and 1.

Returns
(numpy.ndarray): Values (floats) of D for all states

and of E for all states.

phylojunction.distribution.likelihood.ODE.dn_bisse_ode.bisse_e_eqns(es, qs, mus, lambdas)

Return Maddison et al. d/dt E(t) equations.

Parameters:

  • es (numpy.ndarray) – Values of Es for states 0 and 1.

  • qs (numpy.ndarray) – Two-dimensional array of values of transition rate parameters for states 0 and 1.

  • mus (numpy.ndarray) – Values of extinction rate parameters for states 0 and 1.

  • lambdas (numpy.ndarray) – Two-dimensional array of values of birth-rate parameters for states 0 and 1.

Returns:

Values (floats) of E for states 0 and 1

Return type:

(tuple)
